approval: User: approve all; prefer Pashto where best matched, then Urdu for broadly Perso-Arabic terms. Approval includes qualified analyses, not a claim that uncertainties are resolved.
donor_policy: Prefer an attested Pashto donor where form and meaning fit best; otherwise prefer Urdu for broadly shared Perso-Arabic loans. Preserve explicit source attribution, phonological uncertainty and possible Nuristani mediation. Do not substitute a different dialect merely because its node is linkable.
